verdict: Quiet day for pipeline-relevant news: one real model-availability item worth noting, the rest is research-paper churn, marketing fluff, and VFX breakdown PR with no technical substance.

stories.headline: MiniMax-H3-Turbo weights published on Hugging Face, ComfyUI-tagged
stories.body: A Turbo variant of MiniMax-H3 was published to Hugging Face, based on MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3, using the diffusers library and tagged for ComfyUI compatibility. Licence is listed as "other" rather than a standard permissive licence, so usability on client work needs checking before adoption. No download or performance numbers are verified beyond the listing itself.
stories.why: Another MiniMax-H3 variant moving toward ComfyUI, but licence terms need verification before studio use.

stories.headline: Substance 3D Painter 12.2 adds cage painting directly on the model
stories.body: Adobe's Substance 3D Painter 12.2 lets artists paint baking cages directly on the mesh, plus smarter Polygon Fill selections, texture-set highlighting, and improved real-time rendering for overlapping transparent materials. This is a texturing-tool update, not AI-driven, but it changes a concrete step in the baking workflow for anyone running Painter in production.
stories.why: Direct workflow change for texture artists baking cages, available now in a shipping tool update.

stories.headline: Moho 14.5 adds live webcam-driven rig performance mode
stories.body: A free update for Moho 14.5 owners adds Live Mode, which drives existing rigs via webcam face tracking, gamepad input, and live physics, streaming the performance to broadcast software. It also adds EXR and PNG export with colour profiles and improvements to the Batch Exporter. Relevant mainly to 2D animation pipelines rather than USD/Houdini work.
stories.why: Niche for this reader's pipeline but a concrete, shipping feature with real-time animation implications.

stories.headline: I Used AI to Create a Massive 3D Printed D&D City
stories.body: Integrating Vision-LLMs to perform complex geometric tasks like model segmentation and interactive assembly documentation.
stories.why: The methodology of using LLMs to drive scene-management scripts can be adapted to Houdini for procedural kit-bashing and modular assembly.
